posts.name: hstein3
posts.cooked:
Dandolo:

Is that Expat? I thought it was supposed to be The Operative.

You know, I could see that. I figured it to be Expatriette for a few reasons:

  1. Dual-wield pistols
  2. Same style of gloves
  3. Facial scars (You can't see her right eye, so this isn't a great indicator.)
  4. Similar stances
  5. The theme of many of the heroes in that picture is hero combos. You have Skyscraper/Tempest, Setback/Legacy, and Captain Cosmic/Parse.

I still think the theme of the characters is probably the easiest way to look at it. You have two different themes happening there. You have different alignment villains, probably along nemesis lines (looks like Akash'Bhuta with Argent Adept's signature neon-green glow, a holy Apostate, and a heroic Ermine.) You also have the blended heroes. That makes me think it's an Expatriette/Chrono-Ranger mashup, because any other combination doesn't really fit the themes you see in the other characters.
